wax_and_wick.name: Case File I — Wax & Wick
wax_and_wick.question: Elspeth died the week the Chandlers bought all her debts.
wax_and_wick.aphorism: Cats do not believe in coincidence. Coincidence is what mice call carelessness.

suspects.name: The Unpicked
suspects.line: The shape in the parlor, wearing threads that were not its own.

suspects.name: Guildmaster Wick
suspects.line: Master of the Chandlers. Bought every debt she owed, the week she died.

suspects.name: The Quiet Gentleman
suspects.line: A fixer who owns favors the way banks own houses.

evidence.name: The Sealed Stub
evidence.found_line: A candle stub with a guild seal on it. Somebody paid for her light.
evidence.note: Chandlers' seal, Thimblefield delivery mark. No chandler delivers to witches on credit — and nobody was billing her.

evidence.name: The Bought Debts
evidence.found_line: A ledger page in a guildmaster's own hand. He did not expect it read aloud.
evidence.note: Buy Vane's paper, all of it; call it due Lady's Day. He wanted her evicted. You do not evict a woman you have had killed.

evidence.name: The Unpaid Ward
evidence.found_line: A Lamplighters' shift-tally, kept out of spite and therefore kept honestly.
evidence.note: Wick stopped paying for the Wickhouse ward two years ago. She kept sewing it anyway. Free. Nobody sews free.

evidence.name: The Backward Seam
evidence.found_line: A hand's length of ward-thread, taken off the Wickhouse seam.
evidence.note: The ward was not broken. It was unpicked — in her own stitch, mirror-handed. Elspeth taught exactly nobody.

evidence.name: The Undelivered Docket
evidence.found_line: A delivery docket for Needle Lane. Signed out on the night. Never delivered.
evidence.note: Someone borrowed the Chandlers' cart-slot to walk up her street unremarked. Someone with guild paper, or very good forgeries.

leads.name: The Smell of Money
leads.recap_line: Beeswax burns in Wickrow. Somebody paid for her light.
leads.board_card: Beeswax at the parlor window. Cheap tallow burns in Thimblefield. Beeswax is Wickrow money.

leads.name: Creditors
leads.recap_line: The Chandlers bought every debt she owed. Last month.
leads.board_card: The Chandlers' bank bought every debt Elspeth owed. Last month. All at once. Banks are not sentimental.

leads.name: The Lamplighters Talk
leads.recap_line: The Lamplighters hate the Chandlers. Hate is chatty.
leads.board_card: The Lamplighters hate the Chandlers professionally. Hate is chatty.

leads.name: The Ward That Failed
leads.recap_line: Her last stitching holds the Wickhouse. Go and read it.
leads.board_card: The Wickhouse ward is Elspeth's stitching. Go read her last work. Bring nothing that burns.

leads.name: An Audience of Wax
leads.recap_line: Guildmaster Wick will see you now. Mind the big one.
leads.board_card: Guildmaster Wick will see you now. Everyone in Wickrow is suddenly very polite. Mind the big one.
